baseline_input.page_number_convention: Physical page 1 is cover; physical pages 2–4 carry roman i–iii; physical 5 begins printed page 1; printed page equals physical minus 4 thereafter.
baseline_input.binding_note: This report records inspection of the frozen pre-layout-pass PDF. Its pathname may now hold a rebuilt PDF; all baseline images remain bound to the recorded input hash.

method.skill: PDF inspection skill; read-only use, no authoring marker invoked
method.rendering: All 99 baseline pages rendered with Poppler pdftoppm at 120 dpi, 1020×1320 px. Contact sheets use four pages per image except the final three-page sheet. Supplementary reviewer rendered physical 40–79 at 144 dpi, 1224×1584 px.
visual_checks: Text and formula containment and clipping
Mathematical glyph, subscript, and superscript readability
Overlap, accidental blank pages, and page-boundary flow
Placement of figures relative to statements and proofs
method.scope: Visual layout review. No new claim of proof verification or formal coverage follows from this report.

coverage.note: Coverage distinguishes personal contact/full-page inspection from the supplementary reviewer. Rendering alone is not counted as visual inspection. All six main figures, the formal ledger, dense mathematical sections, and all 24 atlas plates received full-page inspection.

findings.title: Figure 5 interrupts the statement of Theorem 21.3
findings.description: Theorem 21.3 begins near the bottom of physical page 49 with Suppose and a commutative square. A full-page Figure 5 occupies physical page 50. The theorem resumes at the top of physical page 51 with is a commuting square. Then. The inserted figure splits one theorem statement and sentence.
findings.source_boundary: Immediately after the Figure 5 environment, before the theorem carrying label thm:obstruction_naturality (baseline source around lines 943–950).
findings.minimal_repair: Flush Figure 5 before Theorem 21.3; insert a clearpage after the figure environment and before the theorem, rebuild, then inspect the affected pages.
findings.mathematical_implication: None. This is a layout/readability finding, not a proof or statement defect.
findings.disposition: Reported to root immediately. Root is applying the single layout correction. No manuscript or PDF edited by this reviewer.

observations: No other visible clipping, missing glyph boxes, overlapping formulas, or unreadable mathematical text was found at the inspected scales.
No accidental blank pages were found. Short section-boundary pages, dedicated figure pages, and the appendix introduction are intentional.
The Section 17 Figure 4 at physical page 38 falls between complete theorem/proof material on page 37 and the norm proposition beginning on page 39.
Figure 6 at physical page 71 follows the complete Theorem 27.8 proof and precedes Corollary 27.9.
Ordinary direct page continuations of statements or proofs were not treated as defects. The material Figure 5 case inserts an entire figure page inside one statement.
Full-page review of all atlas plates, physical 75–98, found diagrams, matrices, tables, labels, captions, and callouts contained and readable.

supplementary_geometry.note: Text bounding-box and extracted-text checks supplement visual inspection; they do not establish visual quality by themselves.
